sam.k: Heads-up: small docs PR incoming to clarify Dedicated traffic-splitting + isolation examples. Will add JS + Python SDK snippets and a migration note for renamed fields (max_batches -> max_concurrent_batches).

lee: I can take the Python snippet and double-check the traffic-split example for canary rollouts. Suggest showing a 90/10 split with a pinned fallback model.

anya: I'll update the prose: clarify that under strict isolation traffic-split weights are honored but overflow may be preempted and routed to fallback variants. Also will swap 'eviction' -> 'preemption' everywhere.

docs-bot: link-checker: dedicated/traffic-split.md -> broken anchor at line 56: `#canary-setup` (missing). Suggest `#canary-rollout`.

sam.k: thanks bot. I'll fix the anchor and crosslinks. Draft JS snippet (short):
```js
// traffic split with fallback pinned model
await client.dedicated.updateTrafficSplit('pool-id', {
  routes: [
    { model: 'v2', weight: 90 },
    { model: 'v1', weight: 10 }
  ],
  fallback_model: 'v1',
  isolation_level: 'balanced',
  max_concurrent_batches: 6
});
```

lee: Python snippet I'll add:
```python
policy = {
  "routes": [{"model": "v2", "weight": 90}, {"model": "v1", "weight": 10}],
  "fallback_model": "v1",
  "isolation_level": "balanced",
  "max_concurrent_batches": 6,
}
client.dedicated.update_traffic_split('pool-id', policy)
```

anya: small migration blurb: "If you previously used `max_batches` rename to `max_concurrent_batches`. For regulated workloads, prefer `isolation_level: strict` and pin fallback models; burst capacity may be disabled in strict mode." I'll add that to the PR.

docs-bot: preview build: traffic-split.md -> warnings: code blocks need language tags; anchor fixed in branch.

sam.k: I'll push PR today and tag @anya and @lee for quick review. Aim to merge within 24h so console rollout can reference updated snippets. :rocket:
